compatibility_claims.description: PCFSoftShadowMap is marked @deprecated in constants.js:73 and actively intercepted with a removal warning in WebGL and WebGPU renderers, falling back to PCFShadowMap.
compatibility_claims.notes: Code using PCFSoftShadowMap emits console warnings in browser runtime and is coerced to PCFShadowMap.

compatibility_claims.description: RGBELoader extends HDRLoader and emits deprecation warning recommending HDRLoader.
compatibility_claims.notes: Addon loader transition introduced in r180.

compatibility_claims.description: PostProcessing is deprecated in favor of RenderPipeline for WebGPU pass composition.
sRGBEncoding was replaced by SRGBColorSpace constant in r152. Constants export confirms SRGBColorSpace and absence of legacy encoding constants.
compatibility_claims.notes: Legacy encoding constants are completely absent from constants.js.

compatibility_claims.description: renderer.outputEncoding was replaced by renderer.outputColorSpace in r152. WebGLRenderer confirms getter/setter outputColorSpace and absence of outputEncoding.
compatibility_claims.notes: Legacy outputEncoding property is completely removed.

compatibility_claims.description: THREE.Geometry was removed in r125; all meshes must use BufferGeometry. BufferGeometry.js confirms standard representation and absence of legacy Geometry.
compatibility_claims.notes: Legacy Geometry class is completely absent from core.

known_limitations: Multi-version backwards compatibility range (<0.180.0) is not verified by automated test fixtures.
